heading_en: Approval Before the Application Date Concerning the Use of the ILM in the Standardized Measurement Approach
summary_ja: ILM利用の承認を適用日前に申請・承認でき、また非AMA採用者は当分の間、直近十年間を五年間とできる。
summary_en: Approval to use the ILM may be applied for and granted before the Application Date; non-AMA institutions may for the time being use five years instead of ten.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company may, even before the Application Date, in accordance with Article 287 of the New Public Notice, apply for approval for the use of the ILM in the standardized measurement approach.

Where an application has been made pursuant to the preceding paragraph, the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency may grant approval in accordance with Article 286, paragraph (1) or (2) of the New Public Notice. In this case, that approval is deemed to have been granted on the Application Date pursuant to those provisions.

With respect to the application of Article 288, item (i), sub-item (a) of the New Public Notice to an Ultimate Designated Parent Company that has not used the advanced measurement approach in calculating the operational risk equivalent amount under the Former Public Notice, the words "the most recent ten years" in the provisions of sub-item (a) of that item may, for the time being, be read as "the most recent five years".
